newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya sells $61.3 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Kenya sells $61.3 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Kenya sold 3.372 billion shillings ($61.3 million) of treasury bills at the weekly auction on Thursday, bank officials said on Friday.
Of the total, the bank said it sold 3.247 billion shillings in the main 91-day category of bills at an average yield of 21.363 percent, against a yield of 21.404 percent last week.
In the 28-day category, the bank sold 125 million shillings at an average yield of 16.754 percent, unchanged on the week.
The bank invited tenders for six billion shillings of treasury bills for the auction on Thursday next week.
